# coval_run_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval run template by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_run_template" "regression" {
  id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Run-template ID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) Agent IDs included in the template.
- `concurrency` (Number) Maximum number of simulations run concurrently.
- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) ID of the user who created the run template when available.
- `description` (String) Run-template description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable run-template name.
- `iteration_count` (Number) Number of times each test case runs.
- `metadata` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing run-template metadata.
- `metric_ids` (Set of String) Metric IDs evaluated by the template.
- `mutation_ids` (Set of String) Mutation IDs used for A/B testing.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `persona_ids` (Set of String) Persona IDs included in the template.
- `sub_sample_seed` (Number) Random seed for reproducible sub-sampling.
- `sub_sample_size` (Number) Number of test cases sampled randomly.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the run template.
- `test_set_ids` (Set of String) Test-set IDs included in the template.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.
